actual_authoring_policy.implementation_behavior: SHA-256-derived roll modulo 10 reserves roll 0 for public-evaluation authoring focus; otherwise selection is from normal_ids.
actual_authoring_policy.normal_tier_meaning: approved original-family generators missing parameter extensions
actual_authoring_policy.scope: Authoring assignment probabilities only; no training admission or dataset weight is changed.

metrics: four-query episodes with four distinct inputs and Racket labels
bounded_test.stopping_rule: After at least three assignments in each non-evaluation stratum, stop expanding a new stratum if fewer than half are routine-complete or if its median reviewer minutes exceed twice the approved-parameter stratum without at least a 20% gain in accepted parameter settings per 100 Racket label executions. Immediately stop on any training-admission leakage or hidden-answer exposure.

cost_basis_examples: The selected repair required a 12-stage battery, 55 portable tests, 300 lessons/900 rotations, and a 19-label parametric replay.
Sample e69a3b575440 requires eight demonstrations per production lesson and records 2,700 rotations, illustrating that accepted data can still be costly.
Sample 66ba1145a9b7 has multiple unresolved contract defects, illustrating why repair-stratum assignments can be materially more expensive than parameter-only work.
alternative_allocation_estimate.estimate_status: proposal based on packet evidence; not empirically validated by this audit
alternative_allocation_estimate.expected_tradeoff: Compared with the current approximately 90% normal emphasis on approved originals missing parameters, the pilot should reduce parameter/evidence debt and convert more proposed work into reusable four-query supervision, at the cost of lower routine throughput and more Racket/review work in the repair stratum.
alternative_allocation_estimate.kind: bounded authoring-policy pilot; not a dataset-weight change

catalog_weight_observation.assessment: All three rows have mix_weight 1.0 despite materially different approval/evidence states. This is not necessarily a dataset defect because admission/approval can gate sampling; the packet does not establish that unapproved rows are sampled into training. It does show that mix_weight alone must never be interpreted as quality or admission.

coverage_limit: All three random IDs are bank-sourced and none belongs to the current 250-ID normal authoring pool. The sample therefore diagnoses broad catalog evidence heterogeneity, not the quality rate of the current normal assignment pool, and it cannot support ARC-GEN/RE-ARC source conclusions.

2bcad02eb7da.assessment: The generator declares exact axes and a five-example curriculum, but this packet contains no source-bound decision receipt or focused task-test directory. It should not be treated as evidence-equivalent to an approved reviewed generator merely because its catalog weight is 1.0.
2bcad02eb7da.classification: unapproved generator with plausible task-local design but little retained current-source review evidence

66ba1145a9b7.assessment: The source-bound audit reproduces inert palette/texture controls, axis-domain mismatches, an exceeded stray-count cap, and a validator palette hole. Catalog weight 1.0 is not quality evidence and must remain downstream of approval/admission gates.
66ba1145a9b7.classification: unapproved generator with unresolved current-source contract defects

e69a3b575440.assessment: This is high-confidence ordered-production data, but each lesson spends eight demonstrations. The retained 2,100/2,700 rotation hook warnings show that equal query-placement assumptions would be unsafe; cost and curriculum policy matter in addition to approval.
e69a3b575440.classification: approved reviewed generator with strong production evidence but an expensive ordered curriculum
